# Constraint finder (Bayram Annakov)

Finds the single bottleneck in a process using Goldratt's Theory of Constraints.

- Source: https://github.com/BayramAnnakov/systems-thinking-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BayramAnnakov/systems-thinking-skills/main/skills/constraint-finder/SKILL.md
- Author: Bayram Annakov
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/constraint-finder-bayram-annakov-70d7f968

Given a process and the goal it serves, Claude identifies the one binding constraint, says whether it is a resource or (more often) a policy, and lays out the five focusing steps as concrete actions in order, with the free moves before spending money. It first insists on a clear throughput goal, checks whether a stable constraint exists at all, and warns against optimizing steps that are not the constraint. It responds in the user's language.

**Try asking:**
- "Here is our hiring pipeline and goal. Find the constraint"
- "Our support team is always behind. Interview me to find the bottleneck"
- "Apply the 5 focusing steps to our release process"

**Source:** [BayramAnnakov/systems-thinking-skills](https://github.com/BayramAnnakov/systems-thinking-skills/tree/HEAD/skills/constraint-finder) · MIT · by Bayram Annakov
